historical_result_policy: V1 and v2 are development records. V3 results remain an immutable diagnostic that exposed a physical-asset identity mismatch. V4 is the confirmatory protocol and must be reported separately.
change_reason: the v3 route-delay diagnostic allowed the mathematical model to reassign the delayed route even though the public dispatcher message explicitly kept the scheduled departure on the named physical bus
bind each asset-specific late-return trip to the physical bus named by the public schedule in every stochastic scenario and in observed-outcome recourse
leave the shared deterministic optimizer, scenario probabilities, prices, disturbance truth, Agent results and economic objectives unchanged

method.asset_identity_constraint: For each publicly named late-return bus, its scheduled trip must remain assigned to that physical bus during every active trip interval; this constraint is added only by the stochastic benchmark wrapper.
method.observed_outcome_recourse: Use the same identity-bound feasibility-first formulation with a probability-one observed scenario.

aw_route6_late_return.public_basis: The dispatcher confirms Bus 6, states that its return is late, and explicitly says its departure remains at the scheduled time.

aw_charger_bank_shutdown.public_basis: The case concerns charger assets and declares no bus-trip identity uncertainty.

aw_combined_evening.public_basis: The combined dispatch messages identify Bus 8 as the vehicle with the late return.
